description: This file defines an abstract class 'ShapeRenderer' responsible for rendering shape objects (images, text frames, charts) into RTF format within the MigraDoc document rendering framework. It includes methods for rendering shape attributes such as position, fill, line, wrap format, and nested shape properties. The class serves as a base for more specific shape renderers and manages the translation of shape properties into corresponding RTF controls.

classes.name: ShapeRenderer
classes.description: An abstract base class for rendering shapes such as images, textframes, and charts into RTF. It manages the conversion of shape properties including position, size, fill, line, and wrap format into corresponding RTF controls, serving as a foundation for specific shape renderers.

methods.name: StartShapeArea
methods.description: Begins the RTF area for rendering a shape, initializing content and writing starting controls.

methods.name: RenderShapeAttributes
methods.description: Renders the common attributes for a shape, including position, wrap, and parent relation indicators.

methods.name: RenderFillFormat
methods.description: Translates the shape's fill format into RTF, determining fill visibility and color.

methods.name: GetLineWidth
methods.description: Returns the line width of the shape if defined; otherwise, a default value.

methods.name: RenderLineFormat
methods.description: Translates the shape's line format, including color, width, and dash style, into RTF controls.

methods.name: RenderTopPosition
methods.description: Calculates and renders the vertical position controls for the shape based on its position type.

methods.name: RenderLeftPosition
methods.description: Calculates and renders the horizontal position controls for the shape based on its position type.

methods.name: GetShapeHeight
methods.description: Provides the shape's height, allowing override for specific shape types.

methods.name: GetShapeWidth
methods.description: Provides the shape's width, allowing override for specific shape types.

methods.name: EndShapeArea
methods.description: Ends the RTF content area for the shape rendering.

methods.name: RenderInParagraph
methods.description: Determines whether the shape should be embedded in a paragraph, affecting positioning and rendering.

methods.name: RenderParagraphAttributes
methods.description: Renders paragraph attributes for shape placement when embedded.

methods.name: RenderParagraphDistances
methods.description: Renders spacing before and after the paragraph wrapping the shape.

methods.name: RenderParagraphAlignment
methods.description: Sets paragraph alignment based on shape's left position properties.

methods.name: RenderRelativeHorizontal
methods.description: Renders the relative horizontal positioning of the shape.

methods.name: RenderRelativeVertical
methods.description: Renders the relative vertical positioning of the shape.

methods.name: RenderWrapFormat
methods.description: Renders the wrap style and distances for the shape.

methods.name: RenderParagraphIndents
methods.description: Computes and renders indentation for the shape's paragraph.

methods.name: RenderLeftRight
methods.description: Calculates and renders the shape's horizontal boundaries (\\shpleft and \\shpright).

methods.name: AlignHorizontally
methods.description: Calculates left and right positions based on shape's horizontal alignment.

methods.name: AlignVertically
methods.description: Calculates top and bottom positions based on shape's vertical alignment.

methods.name: RenderNameValuePair
methods.description: Outputs a shape property as a name-value pair in RTF.

methods.name: StartNameValuePair
methods.description: Begins an RTF shape property name-value pair.

methods.name: EndNameValuePair
methods.description: Ends an RTF shape property name-value pair.

methods.name: TranslateAsNameValuePair
methods.description: Translates a shape property value into RTF and renders as a name-value pair.

methods.name: StartDummyParagraph
methods.description: Starts a dummy paragraph to embed a shape, wrapped in TopBottom style.

methods.name: EndDummyParagraph
methods.description: Ends the dummy paragraph surrounding a shape.
